title: Coherent strict quotient normalization of the transported completed tensor
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme W. Let S be a coefficient derived system calculus and rho its normalized total-limit/Roos comparison [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Construct tensorModelRealization by taking the uniquely strict-Roos-normalized pullbackTensorIntegralTensorModel [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations], then transport its two reduction functors through the unique unit-compatible comparison of left adjoints to the same total limit, and its closed tensor through the canonical transpose-preserving comparison [lem-coef-closed-tensor-comparison]. This explicitly constructed natural isomorphism satisfies IsTensorModelNormalized [def-pur-scalar-extension-tower-data]: on every pair of whole-system coherent good strict quotient presentations it has the prescribed local homogeneous tensor formula and the stated whole-system Roos equation. No residue-characteristic, boundedness or constructibility hypothesis on the inputs is needed.

source.place: Tags 03EL, 06YY, 07A4 and 0941; tensor realization portion of original steps 4 and 8 of lem-pur-scalar-extension-tower-coherence. Whole-system coherence is the same correction already made for scalar/pullback models.

proof.text: Apply coherentReferenceQuotientComparison to each whole-system coherent presentation. This produces ordinary quotient isomorphisms a,b with the prescribed evaluation normalization and the exact derived presentation equations.

The strict tower map q is restriction/evaluation of the total tensor of a inverse and b inverse followed by the reference strict tower comparison. strictQuotientTensorGenerator proves its local formula.

Apply coefficientTensorModelComparison, proved by currying the identity total tensor and using the canonical comparison transpose equation. Naturality of the inverse representative tensor model for the strict maps a,b combines the coherent derived presentation equations with the transported closed tensor comparison.

The two ordinary-limit/Roos augmentations have identical first and second projections, hence agree by mapping-cocone uniqueness. K-injective normalization makes the reference Roos comparison equal the given one. Naturality of the resulting Roos bridge, cancellation of the tensor isomorphism and the reference completed tensor normalization prove the entire FiveStepEquation. A private generic categorical pasting lemma combines the three equations, avoiding repeated unfolding of the concrete derived-category composite.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03EL, 06YY, 07A4 and 0941; original four-step route implemented using coherent reference quotient coordinates, tensor curry normalization, and uniqueness of the normalized Roos comparison.
